test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four parts. Identify the part that contains an error.

(A) One of / (B) my brothers write / (C) novels for / (D) leisure.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'write' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the **subject 'one of my brothers'** is **singular** and requires a **singular verb**.
 
• Therefore, the correct form of the verb should be 'writes' instead of 'write'.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***One of my brothers writes__ novels for leisure*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• When the subject of a sentence is a phrase like **'one of the'** followed by a plural noun, the verb should be in the **singular form** because the subject is singular.

 
 
• **Example:** ***One of the students is__ absent today*.**
